zh-CN.title: TingSub 听桥 · 让直播多一行你看得懂的字幕
zh-CN.description: 为英语、日语直播生成中文与英文字幕。TingSub 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地识别和翻译，提供桌面模型管理与 Chrome 字幕扩展。
zh-CN.eyebrow: 本地运行的直播双语字幕
zh-CN.hero_body: 给英语、日语原声添上中文与英文字幕。识别和翻译都在你的 Mac 上完成，跟上直播，也留住原话。
zh-CN.compat: Apple Silicon · Chrome 116+ · 开源早期预览
zh-CN.demo_hint: 切换原声语言，看看字幕怎么呈现。
zh-CN.demo_note: 预设文字演示，不会播放、采集或识别音频。
zh-CN.scene_label: 沿海旅行 · 字幕样例

facts.label: 只捕获选中的浏览器标签页

zh-CN.product_title:
字幕跟着画面，
节奏留给自己。
zh-CN.product_body: 播放器没有字幕，也可以继续看。用 TingSub 开启当前标签页的字幕，调整字号和位置，按需要保留原文或关闭翻译。

features.title: 听原话，也看懂意思
features.body: 中文与英文并排理解。看日语内容时，可选择「中文＋原文」；只想练听力，就关掉翻译。

features.title: 少一点遮挡
features.body: 字幕跟随视频区域，拖到舒服的位置。长句可展开查看，调试数据默认收起。

features.title: 音频留在本机
features.body: Whisper 识别，Qwen 翻译。模型准备好后本地推理，无需云 API 账号，也不申请麦克风权限。

zh-CN.workspace_title:
模型、字幕、连接。
都在手边。
zh-CN.workspace_body: 在桌面窗口预览字幕、管理模型、配对浏览器。下载多少、存在哪里、遇到问题看什么日志，都有入口。
zh-CN.caption_alt: TingSub 中文桌面字幕工作台：语言、翻译开关与字幕样例
zh-CN.model_alt: TingSub 中文模型管理界面：模型选择、下载源与存储位置
zh-CN.screenshot_note: 真实桌面界面，使用示例字幕与模型状态；不代表实时转录或性能测量。
zh-CN.detail_download_title: 下载有进度，模型能选择
zh-CN.detail_download_body: 查看实际下载进度，选择 Whisper / Qwen 模型。网络较慢时，可尝试社区镜像或自定义 HTTPS 下载源。
zh-CN.detail_control_body: 桌面端与扩展共享字幕设置。选好原声和显示语言，下次开启字幕时生效。
zh-CN.setup_title:
下一场直播，
试着打开听桥。
zh-CN.setup_body: CI 提供 macOS 应用和浏览器插件预览包，也可从源码运行。下载预览包需要登录 GitHub；当前版本尚未经过 Apple 公证。
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac，源码运行需 macOS 14+
安装 uv；建议 16 GB 内存
默认模型约 2.2 GB，另需依赖与缓存空间

steps.title: 启动桌面工作台
steps.body: 按指南获取源码和依赖，打开 TingSub。首次准备模型需要联网。

steps.title: 选择并准备模型
steps.body: 在「本地模型」下载并验证模型。按网络情况选择下载源，再启动服务。

steps.title: 配对 Chrome，开启字幕
steps.body: 加载扩展、粘贴配对码。播放视频后，在扩展中为当前标签页开启字幕。

zh-CN.build_link: 独立 App 构建说明
zh-CN.faq_title: 打开之前，你可能想知道。

faq.q: 支持哪些设备和浏览器？
faq.a: 当前支持 Apple Silicon Mac 与 Chrome 116+。源码运行要求 macOS 14+；独立 App 的最低系统版本取决于构建产物。暂不支持 Intel Mac、Windows、Linux 或 Firefox。

faq.q: 音频会上传吗？能离线使用吗？
faq.a: 识别和翻译都在本机完成，TingSub 不上传音频，不遥测，也不自动录音。安装依赖和首次下载模型需要网络；模型就绪后推理可离线运行，直播网站本身仍需联网。

faq.q: 只能用在 YouTube 上吗？
faq.a: 不限于 YouTube。Chrome 能捕获的普通视频标签页都可尝试，包括 Bilibili 直播。无需视频自带字幕；部分受限页面、跨域嵌入播放器的内部全屏模式可能无法显示字幕。

faq.q: 字幕会不会有延迟或翻错？
faq.a: 会。延迟和准确率受语句长度、语言、模型与 GPU 负载影响；多人同时说话、背景音乐和较长日语句子更容易出错。字幕用于辅助理解，不承诺固定延迟或准确率。

faq.q: 现在能直接下载安装吗？
faq.a: 可以从成功的 main CI 构建下载预览包，文件保留 30 天，需要登录 GitHub；安装指南提供下载入口。还没有正式 Release 或 Chrome 商店版本，扩展需在开发者模式加载。App 已包含运行环境，但尚未经过 Apple 公证。
TingSub 代码采用 MIT 许可。模型权重有各自的许可，默认 Qwen 2.5 3B 使用 Qwen Research License，不能将代码的 MIT 许可当作模型授权。使用或分发前请阅读模型许可说明。

zh-CN.end_title:
想看的内容，
值得听明白。
zh-CN.end_body: 从一场直播、一段访谈开始。
zh-CN.footer_note: 代码 MIT · 模型遵循各自许可

en.title: TingSub · Local bilingual captions for livestreams
en.description: Turn English and Japanese browser audio into Chinese and English captions. Local speech recognition and translation on Apple Silicon, with a desktop app and Chrome extension.
en.hero_body: Add Chinese and English captions to English or Japanese audio. TingSub transcribes and translates on your Mac, so you can follow along and keep the original words close.
en.demo_hint: Switch the spoken language to explore the captions.
en.demo_note: Authored sample text. No audio playback, capture or recognition.

facts.label: Capture only the tab you choose

en.product_title:
Captions in the picture.
You set the pace.
en.product_body: Keep watching even when the player has no captions. Start TingSub for the current tab, adjust the text and position, and choose whether to translate.

features.title: Keep the original close
features.body: Read Chinese alongside English. For Japanese content, choose Chinese + original. Turn translation off when you just want the transcript.

features.title: Leave room for the video
features.body: Captions follow the video area. Drag them where they feel right, expand long lines, and keep diagnostics tucked away.

features.title: Keep audio on your Mac
features.body: Whisper transcribes; Qwen translates. Once models are ready, inference runs locally. No cloud API account or microphone permission needed.

en.workspace_title:
Models, captions, connection.
All within reach.
en.workspace_body: Preview captions, manage models and pair your browser in the desktop window. See download progress, find model files and open logs when you need them.
en.caption_alt: TingSub English caption workspace with language settings, translation toggle and sample captions
en.model_alt: TingSub English model manager showing model selection, download sources and storage location
en.screenshot_note: Actual desktop interface with sample captions and model states; not a live transcription or performance result.
en.detail_download_body: Pick your Whisper and Qwen models and track actual download progress. On slower connections, try the community mirror or a custom HTTPS source.
en.detail_control_body: The desktop app and extension share caption preferences. Your language and translation choices apply when you start the next caption session.
en.setup_title:
Try TingSub
on your next stream.
en.setup_body: CI provides preview builds of the macOS app and browser extension. Source setup is also available. Downloads require a GitHub login; current builds are not Apple-notarized.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac; macOS 14+ for source runs
About 2.2 GB for default models, plus dependencies and caches

steps.title: Open the desktop workspace
steps.body: Follow the guide to get the source and dependencies, then launch TingSub. Initial model preparation needs internet access.

steps.title: Choose and prepare models
steps.body: Download and validate a pair in Local models. Choose a download source for your connection, then start the service.

steps.title: Pair Chrome. Start captions.
steps.body: Load the extension and paste your pairing code. Play a video, then start captions for that tab from the extension.

en.faq_title: Good to know before you start.

faq.a: Apple Silicon Macs with Chrome 116+. Source runs need macOS 14+; standalone app requirements depend on the build. Intel Macs, Windows, Linux and Firefox are not supported yet.

faq.q: Is audio uploaded? Can it work offline?
faq.a: Recognition and translation run on your Mac. TingSub does not upload audio, collect telemetry or automatically record. Dependencies and the first model download need internet. Inference can run offline once models are ready; livestream websites still need their own connection.

No. Try it on ordinary video tabs Chrome can capture, including Bilibili livestreams. Existing player captions are not required. Some restricted pages and fullscreen entered inside cross-origin embedded players cannot show the overlay.

faq.q: How fast and accurate are the captions?
faq.a: Latency and quality vary with sentence length, language, model and GPU load. Overlapping speakers, background music and long Japanese sentences can cause errors or delays. Captions assist understanding; there is no fixed latency or accuracy guarantee.

faq.q: Can I download an installer today?
faq.a: Preview installers are available from successful main CI builds, with a GitHub login and 30-day retention. The setup guide links to download instructions. There is no formal Release or Chrome Web Store listing yet. The app includes its runtime but is not Apple-notarized; load the extension in Developer mode.

TingSub code is MIT. Model weights have separate licenses: the default Qwen 2.5 3B uses the Qwen Research License. MIT does not cover those weights. Read the model license guide before using or distributing them.

en.end_title:
A little closer
to what’s being said.
en.end_body: Start with a stream, a talk, a conversation.
en.footer_tag: Hear the original. Follow the story.
en.footer_note: Code MIT · Models have separate licenses
